name: tandem-local
description: Tandem in your AI assistant: the Tandem MCP connector plus skills to start a client work session with full project context, sync the session back into the project, and onboard up to a first project.

interface.longDescription: Tandem is the shared memory of a customer project: people, decisions, plan, conversations, time. This plugin brings it into your assistant. /start loads where the project stands and guides the work with continuous checks against what the customer validated; /sync records the session back into the project (brief, tasks, time); /setup onboards a new user up to a first project with the sources they choose.
